The '''Iska sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the southwestern [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that bordered [[Elbaran sector/Legends|Elbaran]], [[Masla sector/Legends|Masla]], [[Oriolan sector/Legends|Oriolan]], [[Sombure sector/Legends|Sombure]], [[Yushan sector/Legends|Yushan]] and [[Gendius sector/Legends|Gendius sectors]].<ref name="EAOC" />
